title: Metronome journal event
description: One line of state.jsonl. The journal is append-only, so every event must be self-contained and replayable: replaying the whole file from the start must rebuild the same task set. A torn line is dropped on replay rather than failing the whole file.

kind.description: What happened. task_created carries the initial task; status moves it; field patches fields; note appends prose; task_deleted hides the task on replay. deploy_pending records the base a merge produced; deploy_pending_cleared means a deployer drained it; deploy_lock_acquired/deploy_lock_released are the single-flight guard around the deployer.

task_id.description: The task this event applies to. Required for task-scoped kinds; deploy events are store-scoped and must omit it.

base.description: Present only on deploy_pending: the commit that merge produced and a deployer must drain.

owner.description: Present on deploy_lock_acquired and deploy_lock_released: the deployer that holds, or held, the single-flight lock.

at.description: When the event was written, ISO 8601 UTC.

task.description: Present only on task_created: the full initial task.

status.description: Present only on status: the status the task moved to.

phase.description: Optional on status: the pipeline stage the move belongs to.

fields.description: Present only on field: the fields to patch onto the task.

text.description: Present only on note: the prose to append.
